The reply doesn't state one answer outright. It says barley is reported most often, but notes that the sources conflict. It then undercuts the barley reports by pointing out that all five come from a single owner, while the sugar beet reports come from two independent owners. The stated confidence is 35, which is low. It presents both options and does not clearly prefer either. The reply leans toward neither definitively, so it is undetermined.
